verdict.rationale: Vercel exposes a documented REST API (OpenAPI spec) and an official CLI for deployments, suggesting many UI actions are also API-accessible, but the evidence pack never explicitly claims or demonstrates full feature parity between the API/CLI and the dashboard UI. missing for 10: explicit parity documentation or a comparison showing all UI features (e.g., toolbar, comments, CMS draft mode, flags) are also API-accessible, independent verification of completeness.
